issues.description: The problem statement (UML) specifies getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns an int, but the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning a StudentCount object and includes a StudentCount class. This return-type divergence contradicts the UML/hints in the problem (which guide students to work with an int total) and may confuse students about the expected return type and API to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return an int (and remove or avoid using the StudentCount wrapper), aligning with the UML and task hints; or (B) update the problem statement (UML, task text and examples) and the template to explicitly specify and document a StudentCount return type and provide the StudentCount class/interface so students know to return that type. Prefer option A if the intent is to keep the exercise simple (working with primitive int).
